metadata.datasource: ILFORD DELTA 100 Professional fact sheet (September 2002): spectral sensitivity from the vector paths (p1); characteristic curve (p4) a raster image in the PDF, traced at 600 dpi (grid lines removed, the curve's median per pixel column). Copy from 125px.com's archive of ILFORD documents.

tags.log_sensitivity: SHEET 354-654 nm: the "wedge spectrogram to tungsten light (2850K)" taken as drawn; ASSUMED its 0-1 "Sensitivity" axis is log units and the source is not divided out (as HP5 Plus); ASSUMED held below 354 nm, ASSUMED log-linear tail -0.0286 dex/nm above 654 nm; scale MEASURED so grey 0.184 -> raw 1
tags.density_curves: SHEET for log_exposure -2.63..1.31 (ID-11 stock, 8 1/2 min, 20 C, as the sheet's caption: the one curve the sheet plots; slope 0.3-1.5 over base+fog 0.758); ASSUMED flat toe below, ASSUMED straight line slope 0.783 into a ceiling of gross D 3.0 above
tags.log_exposure_anchor: ASSUMED: the sheet's exposure axis is relative. 0 = one log unit above the curve's own D = base+fog + 0.1 point, i.e. the film is taken to have exactly its rated speed (ISO 100: log10(0.8/100)+1.0 = -1.097 log lux-s)
tags.channel_density: ASSUMED: neutral silver, 1/3 per channel at every wavelength
tags.density_curves_layers: ASSUMED: three-CDF fit of the curve (max fit error 0.0465 D), no sheet data on emulsion sub-layers
